label: GazelleGames
description: GazelleGames' own api.php JSON API (?request=…). Despite the shared filename this has nothing in common with the 'Gazelle (api.php)' type beyond the {status,response,error} envelope — different query grammar, different response shapes, and stats need three chained calls. The API key identifies the current user and is sent in the X-API-Key header. HTML profile scraping is not required.
notes: capabilities.api_stats mirrors exactly what fetchGazelleGames in internal/fetch/fetch.go emits — a fixed set, so change one and change the other. TestFetcherCapabilitiesMatchDefs asserts they agree.
